summaryZh: Kargo与Lineage合作，在阿拉巴马州迪凯特的家禽仓库成功部署AI视觉自动化收货系统。该系统通过摄像头塔自动捕获入库托盘的SKU和批号信息，并直接传入WMS，将收货时间从分钟级缩短至秒级，6个月内处理超6.4万笔收货，日均处理500余托盘。此举提升了准确率和效率，释放劳动力用于高附加值工作，为食品冷链物流树立了新标杆。
featuredReason: 该案例展示了AI视觉自动化在冷链物流中的应用，为家禽等易腐食品供应链的收货环节提供了高效、准确的解决方案，对智慧畜牧产业链的物流优化具有直接参考价值。

DECATUR, Ala. — Kargo, an AI-powered vision system for automated inventory capture, and Lineage, a provider of global temperature-controlled warehouses, announce the successful implementation of automated receiving operations at Lineage’s Decatur, Ala. warehouse.

The facility supports adjacent poultry plants and now leverages Kargo’s camera towers to automatically capture inbound inventory data, which include SKU and lot information, and feed it directly into Lineage’s warehouse management system (WMS), the companies said in the announcement.

Receiving is often a bottleneck in warehouse material flow, especially in high-volume food manufacturing environments where accuracy and traceability are paramount. Traditionally, receiving teams must manually scan pallets, verify data against bills of lading and key information into the WMS, which are time-consuming and error-prone processes, the companies added.

By deploying Kargo’s AI-driven camera towers, Lineage has automated more than 64,000 receipts in the last six months, the company said, adding that, the system now automatically identifies and logs each pallet as it arrives, reducing what once took minutes to seconds. The Decatur operation processes more than 500 pallets per day, and the automation has allowed Lineage to reallocate labor to more value-added activities across the facility.

“The Kargo system is helping us remove friction from one of the most labor-intensive parts of the warehouse operation,” Elliott Wolf, Lineage vice president and chief data scientist, said. “By automating receiving, we’re not only improving accuracy and speed, but also empowering our team to focus on higher-impact work.”

For Lineage’s customers, this streamlined inbound flow has translated directly into greater operational throughput and efficiency, officials noted. With faster receiving and more consistent data capture, the product can move seamlessly from production to storage and shipping without delay.

“This deployment represents a milestone in how food logistics and AI can work together,” Sam Lurye, Kargo’s CEO said. “By connecting real-world product flow to digital systems in real time, Kargo and Lineage are setting a new standard for automated supply chain operations.”

The Decatur implementation is part of Lineage’s broader initiative to deploy advanced automation and computer vision technologies that improve efficiencies in cold chain operations, the company added. Automated load scanning, which is increases throughput, is scheduled to launch in Decatur shortly.

translationZh:
迪凯特，阿拉巴马州——AI动力视觉系统供应商Kargo与全球温控仓储服务商Lineage共同宣布，在Lineage位于阿拉巴马州迪凯特的仓库成功实施自动化收货作业。

该仓库为邻近的家禽加工厂提供支持，现已利用Kargo的摄像头塔自动捕获入库库存数据（包括SKU和批号信息），并直接输入Lineage的仓库管理系统（WMS），两家公司在公告中表示。

收货通常是仓库物料流动中的瓶颈，尤其是在高产量食品制造环境中，准确性和可追溯性至关重要。传统上，收货团队必须手动扫描托盘、对照提单验证数据并将信息输入WMS，这些流程耗时且容易出错，两家公司补充道。

通过部署Kargo的AI驱动摄像头塔，Lineage在过去六个月中自动化处理了超过64,000笔收货，公司表示，该系统现在能在托盘到达时自动识别并记录每个托盘，将原本需要几分钟的操作缩短至几秒钟。迪凯特运营点每天处理超过500个托盘，自动化使Lineage能够将劳动力重新分配到整个设施中更有价值的活动中。

“Kargo系统正在帮助我们消除仓库运营中劳动最密集环节之一的摩擦，”Lineage副总裁兼首席数据科学家Elliott Wolf表示。“通过自动化收货，我们不仅提高了准确性和速度，还让我们的团队能够专注于更高影响力的工作。”

对于Lineage的客户而言，这种简化的入库流程直接转化为更高的运营吞吐量和效率，官员们指出。凭借更快的收货和更一致的数据捕获，产品可以无缝地从生产转移到存储和运输，而不会出现延误。

“这次部署代表了食品物流与AI协同工作的一个里程碑，”Kargo首席执行官Sam Lurye表示。“通过将现实世界的产品流实时连接到数字系统，Kargo和Lineage正在为自动化供应链运营树立新标准。”

迪凯特的实施是Lineage更广泛计划的一部分，该计划旨在部署先进的自动化和计算机视觉技术，以提高冷链运营效率，公司补充道。自动装货扫描（可提高吞吐量）预计不久将在迪凯特启动。
